Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment involves two distinct MS approaches: 1) Chemical cross-linking (XL-MS) using DMTMM to study LUBAC structure, and 2) PTM analysis to identify oxyester-linked ubiquitin branches (GG-remnants on Ser/Thr/Tyr). The search parameters explicitly include ubiquitination on non-canonical residues (S, T, Y), which is the primary goal of the assay.

scope: For cross-linking preparations, 100 µg of recombinant LUBAC were cross-linked

we expressed HOIP (119.8 kDa), N-terminally His-tagged HOIL-1L (59.2 kDa), and N-terminally Strep(II)-tagged SHARPIN (43.0 kDa) in insect cells in order to co-purify the LUBAC holoenzyme by tandem affinity chromatography.
Cross-linked peptides were separated on an UltiMate 3000 RSLC nano HPLC system (Thermo Fisher Scientific) coupled to an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribid mass spectrometer
